# Workspaces API

Workspaces are for source-backed code workloads. Database, cache, and queue templates cannot be opened as code workspaces. File and runtime operations may hydrate source or start runtime infrastructure.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace` | [List workspaces](#op-get-v1-workspace) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace` | [Create workspace](#op-post-v1-workspace) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}` | [Get workspace](#op-get-v1-workspace-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/workspace/{id}` | [Update workspace](#op-put-v1-workspace-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/workspace/{id}` | [Delete workspace](#op-delete-v1-workspace-id) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/tree` | [List workspace files](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-tree) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/file` | [Read workspace file](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-file) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/file` | [Write workspace file](#op-put-v1-workspace-id-file) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/file` | [Delete workspace file](#op-delete-v1-workspace-id-file) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/file/move` | [Move workspace file](#op-post-v1-workspace-id-file-move) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/commands` | [Run workspace lint](#op-post-v1-workspace-id-commands) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/commands/{command_id}` | [Get workspace command status](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-commands-command-id) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/commands/{command_id}/logs` | [Get workspace command logs](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-commands-command-id-logs) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/run` | [Get workspace runtime status](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-run) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/run/start` | [Start workspace preview](#op-post-v1-workspace-id-run-start) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/run/stop` | [Stop workspace preview](#op-post-v1-workspace-id-run-stop) |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/run/restart` | [Restart workspace preview](#op-post-v1-workspace-id-run-restart) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/git/status` | [Get workspace Git status](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-git-status) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/git/log` | [Get workspace Git history](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-git-log) |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace/{id}/git/branches` | [List workspace Git branches](#op-get-v1-workspace-id-git-branches) |

## List workspaces {#op-get-v1-workspace}

`GET /v1/workspace`

Returns a paginated list of Workspace

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/workspace" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of Workspace

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].base_build_id` | string |  |
| `data[].base_source_artifact_id` | string | API source artifact record used to hydrate the workspace |
| `data[].branch` | string |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].metadata` | object |  |
| `data[].name` | string |  |
| `data[].owner_id` | string |  |
| `data[].repository_url` | string | Git repository URL |
| `data[].runtime_status` | string |  Allowed: idle, running, stopped, failed. |
| `data[].source_manifest` | string | Project adios manifest path within the composed workspace source root |
| `data[].source_workdir` | string | Project working directory within the composed workspace source root |
| `data[].status` | string |  Allowed: active, archived, deleted. |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].workload_id` | string |  |
| `data[].workspace_id` | string |  |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

Illustrative example; not a live response:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "base_build_id": "example",
      "base_source_artifact_id": "",
      "branch": "",
      "created_at": 1791072000,
      "deleted_at": 0,
      "metadata": {},
      "name": "postman-example",
      "owner_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "repository_url": "example",
      "runtime_status": "idle",
      "source_manifest": "adios.yaml",
      "source_workdir": ".",
      "status": "active",
      "team_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "updated_at": 1791072000,
      "workload_id": "",
      "workspace_id": "000000000000000000000000001"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 1,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```


## Create workspace {#op-post-v1-workspace}

`POST /v1/workspace`

Creates a new Workspace

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Request fields (the body contains an editable example):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_build_id` | string | no |  |
| `base_source_artifact_id` | string | no | API source artifact record used to hydrate the workspace Default: `""`. |
| `branch` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `metadata` | object | no |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `owner_id` | string | yes |  |
| `repository_url` | string | no | Git repository URL |
| `runtime_status` | string | no |  Allowed: idle, running, stopped, failed. Default: `"idle"`. |
| `source_manifest` | string | no | Project adios manifest path within the composed workspace source root Default: `"adios.yaml"`. |
| `source_workdir` | string | no | Project working directory within the composed workspace source root Default: `"."`. |
| `status` | string | yes |  Allowed: active, archived, deleted. Default: `"active"`. |
| `team_id` | string | yes |  |
| `workload_id` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request POST "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/workspace" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "team_id": "YOUR_TEAM_ID",
  "owner_id": "YOUR_USER_ID",
  "name": "postman-workspace",
  "status": "active",
  "workload_id": "YOUR_WORKLOAD_ID"
}
JSON
```

Replace `YOUR_*` body placeholders before sending. The quoted heredoc keeps the JSON literal.
